dogecoin.text:
Our next round of governance voting is here!

Users will be able to vote on the next blockchain we’ll be releasing, choosing between #FantomFDN, #Avalanche, #HECO, #Dogecoin, #OKEX, & #CELO!

The amount of $RBC / $BRBC you hold equals your voting power.

https://t.co/7e2qExainx https://t.co/nw5ldOLoXg

2 more days until the end of our second round of governance voting!

We’re happy to see our community coming together & deciding amongst themselves which blockchain would be the most beneficial - and right now the lead contenders are #FantomFDN & #Dogecoin.

Which will it be? 🤔
